shadows_of_the_market.title: Shadows in the Market
shadows_of_the_market.description: Hooded figures have been seen around the old warehouse at the edge of the market. Violet believes they are cultists - and that someone is supplying them from inside the city.
shadows_of_the_market.objective: Defeat Vargas and break up the cult cell in the old warehouse.

vargas_debt.title: A Debt to Collect
vargas_debt.description: Mirt says Vargas has stopped paying an important debt and now hides in the old warehouse. Mirt wants him reminded of his moral responsibility.
vargas_debt.objective: Find Vargas in the old warehouse and collect Mirt's debt.
